name: Tomasz Holm
headline: Backend Engineer
summary: Backend engineer with experience building reliable services, improving data handling, and supporting product teams from early implementation through production refinement. Comfortable working across backend delivery, integrations, and service architecture in fast-moving environments. Known for practical ownership, clear communication, and steady improvements to stability and throughput.
